findings: Classifier and selection outputs are trained together with selective loss and a coverage penalty.
The loss in cifar10_vgg_selectivenet.py uses fixed lamda32 and a coverage shortfall squared.
selectivnet_utils.py computes risk on accepted samples and includes optional percentile calibration using predicted test scores.
No repository calibration or numerical settings are transferred to Dual-RGBT TEST.
Reference motivates measuring recovery coverage alongside protected-target harm; it does not prove zero harm, tracking performance, or novelty of a reject option.
